propositions: The DC transport must be built on pycontribs/jira (a maintained Python client for Server/DC) as an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra with lazy imports to preserve rebar's zero-dependency contract.
The transport must return raw payload shapes (dicts, not jira.Issue objects) that match the verified-fake contract shared with the Cloud transport, ensuring parity across implementations.
Bearer token auth via JIRA_PAT environment variable and configuration-driven url/project must be validated fail-loud (ConfigError on misconfiguration), never degrading to env-only fallback.
HTTP errors must not be retried (exactly one attempt), while connection timeouts and socket-layer TimeoutErrors must retry with 2s/5s backoff mirroring acli_rest._rest_urlopen_with_retry.

TLS certificate verification must never be disabled; non-https base_url must be rejected unless allow_insecure=true is explicitly set, and allow_insecure must affect only the URL scheme check, not cert verification itself.

The DC backend must self-register via an import statement in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves after importing adapters, catching missing registration as BackendRegistryError at runtime rather than silently failing.
